The workflow file is intentionally visible at the ZIP root.

1. Extract the ZIP.
2. Upload cleanup-legacy-runtime.yml to the root of the Safety-tracker GitHub repo and commit it.
3. Open that uploaded file in GitHub and choose Edit.
4. Change its filename/path to:
   .github/workflows/cleanup-legacy-runtime.yml
5. Commit the rename.
6. Open the Actions tab and run:
   One-time Safety Tracker legacy runtime cleanup

The earlier ZIP looked empty on some Android file managers because folders beginning with a dot, such as .github, are hidden.
